subject: VentureX: SIG control mapping & artifact logistics
messages:
From: Mike Dalton <mdalton@venturex.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SIG control mapping + artifacts for procurement

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement needs a formal control crosswalk (SIG) and supporting artifacts to complete our security review before we move to a contracting call. Can you provide: 

- A control crosswalk mapping Redwood controls to SIG sections (spreadsheet preferred).
- The most recent SOC 2 report (redacted is fine).
- Sample infrastructure/audit logs showing retention and access controls (S3/auditd examples).
- A list of where customer data is stored and retention policy pointers.

Target timeline: we need these by EOD 2027-04-25 to hit our internal review cycle. If there are any controls that take longer, flag them and we can triage.

Also please send any request for NDA/PoE if required.

Best,
Mike
Mike Dalton
Sr. IT Security Manager, VentureX
mdalton@venturex.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Mike Dalton <mdalton@venturex.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG control mapping + artifacts for procurement

Hi Mike — thanks for the clear list and timeline. We can deliver a control crosswalk and the SOC 2 report by 2027-04-25. Two quick clarifications:

1) For audit logs — do you need full raw logs or redacted/sampled logs that show retention and access events?
2) For the data locations/retention callouts, do you want HIPAA-specific language, or is a general retention table OK?

I'm looping in Neha (Security) and Vivek (Infra) to assemble the artifacts and flag any controls that require longer lead time. We will prepare a single zip with the crosswalk, report, and sample artifacts.

Plan:
- 2027-04-19: internal crosswalk draft and artifacts inventory (Neha)
- 2027-04-21: engineering extract of sample logs (Vivek)
- 2027-04-23: internal review & redaction
- 2027-04-25: deliver package to you

If procurement needs an NDA or a DocuSign link for a PoE, send it over and we'll expedite.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-19T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG control mapping + artifacts for procurement

Folks — attaching the initial crosswalk template and a preliminary SOC 2 report (redacted placeholder). Notes:

- crosswalk: redwood_control_crosswalk_venturex_v1.xlsx (column A: SIG control id, column B: Redwood control, column C: artifact pointer). Please review the artifact pointers column and confirm we can share each item as-is or need redaction.
- SOC 2: SOC2-report-2026-redacted.pdf — this is the already-redacted public copy. Full report requires customer NDA; recommend we send the redacted copy first and offer a private artifact review under NDA for any additional details.
- Logs: Vivek to produce a 7-day sample of S3 access logs and an access-review-snapshot.csv that shows admin changes. We'll redact IPs and user identifiers before sending.

Controls that may take additional time:
- 2.7 (third-party monitoring) — we need time to pull contract evidence from the partner team (estimate +5 business days).
- 5.3 (incident postmortem artifacts) — some incidents contain customer-identifiable information; redaction and legal review may add time.

I'll be the point for security clarifications. Tag me for any redaction questions.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_control_crosswalk_venturex_v1.xlsx; SOC2-report-2026-redacted.pdf

On Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 08:45 AM Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Folks — attaching the initial crosswalk template and a preliminary SOC 2 report (redacted placeholder). Notes:

Attached are the log samples and the access snapshot we discussed. Files: s3-audit-log-sample.txt (7-day sample, IPs and user IDs redacted), access-review-snapshot.csv, infra-config-checksum.txt (checksums only).

A couple operational notes:
- The S3 audit sample demonstrates encryption-at-rest and MFA delete operations for the relevant buckets.
- Retention details: our standard retention for customer backups is 90 days; object lifecycle rules object->glacier after 30 days for archival. I'll add that to the crosswalk pointers.

If VentureX needs longer retention or a copy of full logs for an on-site audit, we will need an approved PoE/NDA.

Vivek
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

- The crosswalk looks good at a glance; procurement asked if you can populate the "Evidence Type" column with links or instructions for how we request the raw artifact under NDA.
- We'll send an NDA/PoE via DocuSign this afternoon (expect a HubSpot ticket HS-17542). Once that's signed, procurement will request the non-redacted SOC 2 and a full 30-day log export for a scoped review.
